title: Palace to ex-House Speaker Velasco: Better to explain, face probe to clear your name
summary: It would be better for former House Speaker Lord Allan Velasco to offer an explanation after being implicated in alleged cash deliveries to the Dutertes, Malacañang said Wednesday.
